units: B. Mets. V, 1 איזהו ת׳ what kind of interest is called tarbith?, v. רָבָה.

Ib. 60ᵇ ותיסברא דאיכא נשך בלא ת׳ am I to understand that there may be neshekh (receiving more than loaned) without tarbith (profit)? Ib. נשך איכא … ות׳ ליכא וכ׳ in such a case there is neshekh …, but no tarbith, because he has no profit, having loaned him a Danḳa and received a Danḳa; a. fr.
